messages:
elaine: vendor (AstraScan) kickoff next Mon. They want access to host logs in S3, read access to CloudTrail events, and view-only KMS decrypt for log inspection. Asking for ephemeral roles for 2 weeks. Can we scope and list blockers?

mike: we should avoid long-lived creds. Suggest STS-assumed role with ExternalId + session duration 1h. Provide presigned S3 URLs for bulk exports instead of full bucket list where possible. For KMS, create a key policy allowing "kms:Decrypt" for the assessor role only, no key rotation or ScheduleKeyDeletion perms.

samir: ops note - we can create a dedicated bucket: s3://sec-assessment-logs-usw2, disable public access, turn off replication, and set lifecycle. Will ensure ServerAccessLogging enabled.

elaine: good. I'll also redact any PII from logs beforehand — will create a pre-export scrub script and attest in the evidence pack.

jordan: product question - confirm whether any customer PII might be in those logs (auth headers, email). If yes, need compliance signoff before handoff.

mike: sample CLI for export that we can give them (read-only):
```
aws s3 sync s3://prod-app-logs/2024-05-01 ./export-20240501 --exclude "**/sensitive/**"
aws s3 presign s3://sec-assessment-logs-usw2/export-20240501.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```

samir: also will provide CloudTrail lookup and CloudWatch Logs Insights query outputs, not raw private keys or credentials. We can give them a temporary role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/sec-assessor-usw2 with trust policy limiting sts:ExternalId and SourceIp.

sec-bot: SEC-TICKET CREATED: SEC-4321 - "AstraScan assessment - scope & evidence". Attach NDA and vendor scoping doc.

elaine: I'll draft an evidence checklist: IAM roles snapshot, KMS key policy JSON, S3 bucket policy/ACL, sample CloudTrail query results, redaction script, and the presign command used. Will attach to SEC-4321.

mike: can we limit assessment to us-west-2 to reduce blast radius? Also recommend rate limits on any log API endpoints they might hit.

samir: yes region-limited role. I'll ensure no cross-region replication and remove any bucket public access blocks temporarily if needed, but prefer presigned exports.

jordan: product approves the scoped region. Also ask for a 30-min kickoff call + list of expected tests so we can pre-alert SRE.

elaine: retest window suggestion: 2-week window starting 2024-06-03. Can we confirm by Friday?

mike: I'll add a remediation tracker template and link it to SEC-4321 (columns: vuln, priority, owner, status, proof).

samir: ops will schedule the role creation and presign rotation schedule. ETA EOD Thursday.

elaine: thanks — I'll post the runbook + presigned example and attach NDA in the ticket. Ping me if you see anything risky. :thumbsup:
